What guests mention most

From the photos and what guests write in their Google reviews.

Sheftalia and kebab

16 Google reviews mention the sheftalia, 17 the chicken kebab and 7 the pork chop. The photos show skewers, meatballs and ribs.

Meze and dips

21 reviews mention the meze and 6 the dips. The photos show a table with a Greek salad, olives, dips and flatbread.

Local Cypriot food

10 reviews mention Cypriot food and 9 the local food. Two guests mention the baked feta, one with tomato.

Generous portions

Friendly service

A relaxed atmosphere

One guest describes an extremely relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere and a modern, contemporary feel.
